nodes.title: Control center
widgets_values:
# 🎛️ THE CONTROL CENTER

// MINIMAX H3 CORE CONFIGURATION //

This is the central command hub for the **MiniMax H3 Engine**. Here, you select your generation mode, set video duration, configure aspect ratios, and calibrate sampling parameters.

---

### 1. Operation Selection (Fast Bypasser) 🎛️

This workflow contains **4 specialized generation modules**. Enable ONLY the one you wish to use:

* **Enable T2V:** Pure Text-to-Video generation.
* **Enable Single Image Video:** Image-to-Video from a single reference image.
* **Enable First and Last Frame Video:** Smooth interpolation between a starting keyframe and ending keyframe.
* **Enable Reference To Videos:** Multi-image and audio-driven video synthesis.

---

### 2. Technical Specifications 🛠️

* **Duration:** Set your clip length in seconds (e.g., 5s) max 15s.
* **Resolution Selector:** Choose your aspect ratio and megapixel scaling.
* **Sampler & Seed:** Select your sampler algorithm.

---

### 3. Sampling Scheduler 📈

* **Steps & Denoise:** Calibrate steps (standard: 8 steps) and denoise values (1.00) tailored for your active generation module.

nodes.title: 🎬 MINIMAX H3 PROMPTING GUIDE
widgets_values:
# 🎬 MINIMAX H3 PROMPTING GUIDE

// CINEMATIC DIRECTION & MULTIMODAL SYNTAX //

MiniMax H3 is a multimodal video engine. Prompt it like giving instructions to a film crew—defining camera motion, timestamps, dialogue, and sound design.

---

### 🎥 1. Directing the Scene (The Golden Rule)

* **Direct Shots, Don't Describe Images:** Always specify camera angles (wide, close-up), camera movement (dolly, tracking, static), and timeline cuts.
* **Timestamps:** Use exact timestamps for shot transitions (e.g., `[Shot 1]`, `[Shot 2] At 00:03.000`).

---

### 📝 2. The 3 Core Fields Structure

Every MiniMax H3 base prompt uses 3 dedicated fields:

```text
integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] Describe scene setting, subjects, action, camera movement, dialogue, and synced sound.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, describe the cut, new camera angle, and updated action.

overall_soundscape:
Describe physical in-world sounds (rain, footsteps, room tone, wind, impacts).

non_diegetic_music:
Describe the background music/score (or write "N/A" for no music).
```

---

### 🎙️ 3. Dialogue & Audio Tags

* **Dialogue Format:** Wrap spoken text in `<d>[Language] ... </d>` tags.  
  * *Example:* `A woman (S1) looks at the camera and says: <d>[English] Welcome to the lab.</d>`
* **Speaker IDs:** Assign stable IDs (`S1`, `S2`) to maintain consistent voices across shot cuts.

---

### 🖼️ 4. First-Frame Declaration (For Image Modes)

When using **Single Image Video (I2VA)**, start the prompt with the official alignment line:

```text
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.
```

---

**Link:** Refer to the [Official MiniMax H3 Prompt Guide](https://domoai.app/blog/minimax-h3-prompt-guide) for detailed documentation and advanced prompt templates.

nodes.title: 📥 MEDIA INPUT HUB (IMAGES, AUDIO & VIDEO)
widgets_values:
// INPUT ASSET MANAGEMENT //

This section allows you to upload and prepare your reference assets—images, audio tracks, and reference videos—for your generation modules.

---

### ⚠️ Mixed Input Limitations (Important)
* **Max Total Inputs:** The total combined inputs across all media (Images + Videos + Audio) must **not exceed 12**.

---

### 1. Reference Images 🖼️

* **Image 1 & 2:** Used as keyframes for **Single Image Video** (`Image 1` = Start Frame) and **First & Last Frame Video** (`Image 1` = Start, `Image 2` = End).
* **Images 3** Additional reference slots for multi-image video synthesis (**Reference To Videos** module). 
* **Auto Aspect-Ratio Scaling:** Automatically resizes and crops input images to match the target aspect ratio selected in the Control Center.

---

### 2. Audio Inputs 🎵

* **Audio 1:** Supports up to 3 audio segments (`.mp3`, `.wav`, max 15 seconds total) for setting rhythm, dialogue, or ambient sound.

---

### 3. Video Inputs 🎥

* **Video 1:** Supports up to 3 video clips (2–15 seconds each, max 15 seconds in total) to define camera motion, mirror style, or action logic.

nodes.title: Prompt
widgets_values:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic, live-action, a high-end Chinese classical fashion-film look with a dreamy surreal atmosphere, a near shot begins exactly from <Picture 1>: the young woman with a high black bun tied with a flowing red silk ribbon, long red tassel earrings, and a translucent wine-red to orange-red gradient silk Hanfu with wide sleeves, framed by blooming pink cherry-blossom branches against a dusk sky fading from deep blue to pink-purple. She keeps her original pose, expression, lighting, and composition, one hand raised near her chest with fingertips gently curved. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed as a soft breeze lifts the red ribbon and the tassels sway; she slowly turns her gaze from the side toward the lens. [Shot 2] At 00:02.000, the camera cuts to a close-up of her face, the cherry blossoms softly blurred behind her. She tilts her head slightly and brushes a strand of hair from her cheek, her dark eyes looking into the lens with a quiet, thoughtful expression, the red silk ribbon drifting across her shoulder. The camera holds a static shot as her lips part slightly. [Shot 3] At 00:04.500, the camera cuts to a full-body wide shot revealing her entire figure standing beneath the cherry blossoms, the layered Hanfu skirt and wide sleeves flowing in the breeze as she takes one graceful step forward and turns her body. The camera pulls out with small amplitude at slow speed while cherry petals spiral down around her, the red ribbon streaming behind her against the twilight sky. [Shot 4] At 00:06.500, the camera cuts to a medium close-up of her face and shoulders as she lifts her chin, fixes her eyes directly into the lens, and lets a faint, elegant smile form at the corners of her lips. The camera pushes in slowly with very small amplitude, then holds a static shot as a single petal drifts across the foreground and she holds the final pose until the end of the video.

overall_soundscape: A gentle breeze passes through the cherry blossoms with a soft rustle of silk as she moves, and a few petals whisper through the air; the tassels sway almost silently in the twilight.

non_diegetic_music: A guofeng R&B track at a laid-back moderate tempo, combining plucked guzheng and pipa phrases with a smooth R&B groove built on a soft kick, swung hi-hats, and warm sub-bass; the rhythm stays relaxed and groovy throughout, with the plucked strings becoming more prominent in the final shot and ending on a sustained, fading note.
